text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has a number of victories
under her
belt, but when I think of the
future, there is still
quite a bit of work to
be done.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I work my way through some of the
tasks in
front of me, I find my eyes
beginning to grow
heavy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I'd like to confirm something
about our
upcoming...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Did you fall asleep while working? Good
grief...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose you have hardly had
time to catch
your breath up until now. I
shouldn't be too
surprised.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, the only time
we've
ever celebrated our successes was
around this
time of year. Perhaps we
should make the time to
relax some
more...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Wait... I know!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(We still have that ticket... Maybe now's
the time
to use it?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Air Groove drops by my
office with
a more serious expression
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The hot spring vacation ticket.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The hot spring vacation ticket I gave you
for
safekeeping. Do you still have it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You can hold onto it for the time being.
I'll tell
you when I determine how we
should use it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The memory comes back to me. I think I
should
have the ticket in my desk
drawer...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It looks like you've just remembered.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, the time has come to use it. I'm
going, and I
want you... to come with
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We're leaving the day after tomorrow.
Make sure
to finish up your work and
pack your bags. That's
all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove leaves my office before I
have a
chance to say anything else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still unable to comprehend what exactly
has
happened, I arrive at the hot spring
with Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The water was pretty decent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Apparently this hot spring is good for
tired
muscles and stiff shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What did you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has had a serious expression
for the
whole trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was the one who suggested that we
go... I
wonder what's the matter with her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I say this, Air Groove's mood
does a
180.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What?! I have no idea what you're
talking about!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I could say the same to you! You're
usually much
louder! What's with you
today?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait... No...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That... must be my fault. You're not
talking
because I'm not talking...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh... This isn't what I intended at all...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I thought the vacation ticket was a
perfect
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We've spent the past three years
working hard
without taking a moment
to stop and enjoy
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I guess it became our routine. Even now,
you're
drowning yourself in work.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So I wanted this trip to be a way for you
to relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It makes sense... She was looking out for
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But there's still one thing that I don't
quite get...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, I...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I wasn't sure how to behave.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, this isn't really all that important,
but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh... No, I should stop with the excuses. It's unseemly...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As you know, I am the Empress. I need
to guide
the students at the academy.
Because of that, I
must always be aware
of how others see me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But this place is an exception. Here,
none of that
applies.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As soon as I realized that, I also realized I don't know exactly how I should behave in this situation... How I should act around you...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I hate that I need to show this
shameful
side of myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Air Groove was so focused
on being
the Empress, she forgot how to
be herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the answer is simple.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's what I'm trying to say to you! You're the one who's supposed to be getting pampered here!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your job is to absorb the minerals from
the water,
rest your muscles, and get
some sleep! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove lectures me through our
meal, but I do
manage to relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Air Groove and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
